Summary: LangGraph is typically the cheapest per run because its explicit node structure eliminates redundant LLM calls, with a 3-step task costing $63/month on LangGraph at 1,000 daily runs, compared to $78–$102 on CrewAI and $84–$171 on AutoGen depending on termination conditions. CrewAI's hierarchical mode costs ~30% more than sequential mode due to delegation overhead. LangGraph supports dynamic conditional routing via methods like `addConditionalEdges`, allowing the execution path to change according to the workflow’s state at runtime, which enhances the ability of agents to handle sophisticated, context-driven decisions. CrewAI focuses on sequential and hierarchical processes today, offering structured, predictable control flow and autonomous agent collaboration.
